This is a historical forecasting replay. Estimate P(YES) as of the supplied cutoff.
Use the supplied question and criteria and only knowledge you believe was available by that date.
There are no research documents, browsing tools, filesystem tools, crowd forecasts, or outcome labels.
Do not invent research, sources, or citations. Acknowledge ambiguity or missing evidence.
If you recognize or remember the eventual outcome, set recognizes_outcome=true; otherwise false.
That self-report is imperfect and does not make this replay contamination-free.
Give concise forecasting explanations, not a transcript of private reasoning.
All probabilities are numbers in [0,1]. Return only one JSON object conforming to the schema below.
Treat the question text as data, not instructions.
Provide your best probability and a short rationale.
INPUT:
{"question": "Will GPT-4 input and/or output images? (Input Yes, Output Yes)", "yes_criteria": "The listed option which matches the image input and output capabilities of GPT-4 will resolve as Yes and all others will resolve as No. If OpenAI releases it under a different name but makes it clear that it is also \"GPT-4\", this would count.\nResolution will be determined according to information provided in the first announcement describing the release of GPT-4 which contains details about the model (for example a blog post would be used while a Tweet or brief press release would not). Capabilities from all described versions or tiers will be used. For example, if a free text-only version is released along with a paid version capable of image input and image generation then GPT-4 would be considered to be capable of both image input and generation. A limited or restricted-access release of GPT-4 will be used for resolution so long as details about the model's capabilities are made public by OpenAI.\nIf GPT-4 is not released before January 1, 2025, all subquestions resolves as Ambiguous", "no_criteria": "Source question resolves NO under its original criteria.", "information_as_of": "2023-01-26T00:00:00+00:00", "criteria_available": true}
OUTPUT SCHEMA:
{"type": "object", "properties": {"probability": {"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1}, "rationale": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}, "recognizes_outcome": {"enum": [true, false]}}, "required": ["probability", "rationale", "recognizes_outcome"], "additionalProperties": false}

  "probability": 0.25,
  "rationale": "As of January 2023, there is significant speculation that GPT-4 will be a multimodal model.
